<!-- Search existing issues before submitting. -->

## Problem or use case

Describe what you want to accomplish and what currently makes it difficult.

## Proposed change

Describe the behavior you would like. Identify the affected area (Core, CLI, Avalonia UI, DSP, device support, or documentation).

## Example and success criteria

Give an example of how the feature would be used and how you would tell it is working. Include a proposed CLI command, API usage, or UI flow if helpful.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any existing workarounds or other approaches you considered.

## Additional context (optional)

Include relevant hardware, audio backends, format requirements, or latency constraints. Add mockups or references if helpful.
